title: OfflinePassIssuanceResponse
description: HTTP response body of the server's pass issuance endpoint (POST /api/v1/offline/passes) per spec/profiles/offline/app-contract.md 3. Returns the signed OfflinePass and the trust bundle the app holds while it has no network. The app replaces the bundle it holds with this one on every issuance (app-contract.md 3.4).

stationCas.description: The Station CA set (spec/06-security.md 4.2.1): every Station CA an app accepts a station certificate from now, a new one distributed before it issues and a retired one kept until every certificate it issued has expired, each with its own CRL.

crl.description: This Station CA's current certificate revocation list (spec/06-security.md 2.1.1), PEM.
